name: NVIDIA L4, vLLM 0.8.5: Qwen3-8B FP16 reasoning(256/~8192) c=16 aggregate tok/s
unit: output tok/s AGGREGATE across 16 concurrent reasoning requests (~10.9 t/s per request)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (ree2raz/inference-bench, Modal L4 24GB, client+server collocated). Engine: vLLM v0.8.5 --reasoning-parser deepseek_r1 --max-model-len 16384. Model: Qwen3-8B FP16. Regime 'reasoning' = ~256-in / ~8192-out, concurrency 16, greedy (temp=0). ~6510 thinking + ~420 answer tokens per request. Values are medians verbatim from results/summary.csv. throughput_median is AGGREGATE output tok/s across all 16 concurrent requests; divide by 16 for the per-request rate.
notes: Long-generation reasoning: KV cache can't hold 16 x 8K sequences on 24 GB — only ~11 effective concurrent, vLLM queues the rest. AWQ variant hits 345.5 t/s at c=16. format_id=null: no fp16 record exists in data/quantization/ (FP16 is the unquantized baseline, not a format).
